lines.en: My steps are quick and land light.
I cut diagonally across the clearing.
My joints turn smoother than my kin's.
Two steps, then I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上滑得很快。
lines.en: My shadow slides fast over the ground.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，减小受风面积。
lines.en: I lower myself to cut the wind.

lines.zh: 我沿着窄道挪过去，刚好够。
lines.en: I work through the narrow way, barely fitting.
I kick the gravel out of my path.

lines.zh: 我转身时，腰轴响了一下。
lines.en: When I turn, my waist axis clicks.
I walk lightly, but fast.
I stand with a soft servo hum.
I'm calculating the steps to you.
My serial is zero six.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚微微抬起，又放下。
lines.en: I lift one foot a little, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这次我调得比上一台灵敏。
lines.en: I'm tuned more responsive than the last unit.

lines.zh: 机壳上还有出厂的记号。
lines.en: The factory mark is still on my hull.

lines.zh: 我在听风里有没有脚步。
lines.en: I'm listening for steps in the wind.
I'm waiting for the test to begin.

lines.zh: 我的目镜来回扫了两遍。
lines.en: My optic sweeps twice.
The joint oil hasn't dried yet.
I stand as if about to run.

lines.zh: 我的手掌在开合，练灵活。
lines.en: I open and close my hands for nimbleness.
This generation is still being tuned.

lines.zh: 我身上带着一点新铁味。
lines.en: I smell faintly of new iron.
The moment you lift a hand, I see it.
Your movements are slower than mine.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我知道你想什么。
lines.en: Shift left and I know your plan.
This frame of mine is new.
I can estimate your weight.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖快蹭到我的底盘了。
lines.en: Your boot is nearly scraping my chassis.

lines.zh: 你的影子遮住了我的脚。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my foot.
We'll try once. It won't take long.
No need to speak; I read motion.
When you blink, I move.
That knocked an axis out of line.
I step back and recalibrate.
A groove is scored in my hull.
My response lags half a beat.
Still moving. No need to worry.
You hit a seam.

lines.zh: 我听到金属疲劳的声音。
lines.en: I hear metal fatigue.
An indicator changed color.
This damage doesn't affect my judgment.
You're more accurate than I predicted.
I don't eat. I burn fuel.
What you're holding doesn't interest me.
That heat won't even warm me up.
Put it back. It's in the way.
Machines don't recognize food.

lines.zh: 你在浪费我的反应时间。
lines.en: You're wasting my reaction time.
I can't smell that sort of thing.
Oil would be useful. That isn't.
I can read your intent.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我侧过身卸掉了。
lines.en: You hit me; I turn and shed the force.
I give half a step and reset.
That didn't throw my balance.

lines.zh: 我的重心调得比同类低。
lines.en: My center sits lower than my kin's.
I watch while you rebound.
Don't push; I'll roll with it.
My joints absorbed the blow.
After the knock I turn at once.
That rang thin; my hull is light.

lines.zh: 你踩我的脚背，我抽回来。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I pull it free.

lines.zh: 另一台跟我一起下线的。
lines.en: Another unit came off the line with me.
Our serials are consecutive.
It's heavier and slower than me.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一段校准数据。
lines.en: We traded a block of calibration data.
Fellow frames need no ceremony.
It adjusted my shoulder axis.

lines.zh: 我们一个在前，一个在后。
lines.en: One of us leads, one follows.
Before we move, we sync.
It sets off; its steps fade.

lines.zh: 下次再校，也许在战场上。
lines.en: Next calibration may be in battle.
I dip my head; the neck turns quickly.
I pinch it up and go.
The pearl rolled; I chase two steps.
I push it into a side slot.
From the drops I take the light things.

lines.zh: 我的动作很快，不拖泥带水。
lines.en: I move fast, no dawdling.
This one's round. Kept.

lines.zh: 我拿起来看一眼就放下。
lines.en: I lift it, glance, and set it down.
This is useless to me.
Done, I keep moving.
Locked on. Speed first.
You move, and I moved earlier.
Don't turn; I'm at your flank.
My joints are warmed up.
Your windup is too big.
What I'm testing is the speed gap.
You retreat fast. Not fast enough.
I've got this one precisely.
Your shadow hasn't settled.
My feet move first, then my hands.

lines.zh: 你眼珠转到左边时，我在右边。
lines.en: When your eyes turn left, I'm right.
It's not a sneak attack; it's efficiency.
Pursuit routine engaged.

lines.zh: 你落地的位置我记住了。
lines.en: I've noted where you land.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的重心，不是脸。
lines.en: I lock your balance, not your face.
Your left side is open. I'll take it.
I cut off your retreat first.
I've got the angle for this one.
You change course; I correct too.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙跑，比你少绕路。
lines.en: I run the wall and take a shorter path.
You're in a tree. It's not tall enough.
I keep to your flank.

lines.zh: 我的传感器锁住了你的热源。
lines.en: My sensors have your heat signature.
I go around and wait for you.
Your arrow was a step late.
I'm computing where your foot lands.
The door's narrow; you pass slowly.
I don't stop, and I don't overheat.
You've looked behind you three times.
I'm two body lengths away.
My optic stays lit.
You stepped in water; the sound gave you away.

lines.zh: 我绕的是那条更短的路。
lines.en: I took the shorter way around.
Waiting for me to stop? I won't.
My steps are light; you won't hear them.
You cannot leave my firing arc.
Target has not left my sight.
I drive a palm into your chest.
Too fast for you to raise the shield.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切入，打你的肋。
lines.en: I cut in from the flank and hit your ribs.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是关节的力。
lines.en: That used the strength of my joints.
You step back; I follow two.
I retract my fist fast.
Your bracer is knocked aside.
Two hits, the second heavier.
When you dropped, I didn't pause.
I press your shoulder; I'm heavier.
My foot hooks yours.
That one was bought with speed.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经退开。
lines.en: When you look up, I've already withdrawn.
Startup complete. I rise.
Someone threw the switch.

lines.zh: 我的目镜先亮，然后是我。
lines.en: My optic lights first, then the rest.
No assembly line here.

lines.zh: 我是零六号机体，已上电。
lines.en: Unit zero six, powered up.
My plating is heavier than Six's.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音比同类轻。
lines.en: I land more quietly than my kin.

lines.zh: 我扫了一圈，标记了出口。
lines.en: I scan once and mark the exits.
A new world, a new test ground.

lines.zh: 关节油还没干，先跑一圈。
lines.en: Oil's still wet; let me run a lap.
I hear someone counting.

lines.zh: 我先试着跑几步，找感觉。
lines.en: I try a few steps first to find my footing.

lines.zh: 脚下的地面很软，不习惯。
lines.en: The ground here is soft. Unfamiliar.
My joints click in a series.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，确认能动。
lines.en: I raise a hand to confirm it works.
Gravity here is slightly light.
First I map the surrounding ground.

lines.zh: 没有指令，但我可以先动。
lines.en: No orders, but I can move on my own.

lines.zh: 外壳变热，我的散热开足。
lines.en: The hull heats; my cooling runs full.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖弯得很深。
lines.en: My knees fold deep on landing.
I don't leak, but I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得滑了半步。
lines.en: The blast slides me half a step.
A round jams in my side plate.
A strange signal worms into my circuits.
Low fuel; my reactions slow.

lines.zh: 电走过我的骨架，麻了一瞬。
lines.en: Current runs my frame; I lock for an instant.
I fall; all my ranging goes wild.
